about.en: Zipcoin is an Ethereum token named after the currency in Vitalik Buterin's novel Snowmoon. It pairs a shielded pool, where deposits are withdrawn to fresh addresses under a zero-knowledge proof of ownership, with an onchain messaging scheme in which tokens are burned to publish a signed message permanently. ZC is an ERC-20 at 0x4e67DB19044549fF420860834c91b45BaD298722.
